info.title: API-DocTest-List Fitness Memberships Classes-v3-spec
info.description: The Fitness Memberships Classes API provides access to a comprehensive listing of available fitness classes associated with various membership plans. This endpoint allows users to discover class schedules, details, and availability, helping fitness enthusiasts select the right programs aligned with their membership. Ideal for gyms, fitness centers, and app developers looking to enrich their offerings, this API streamlines the integration of fitness class information into applications. Consumers can utilize this API to enhance user engagement and provide detailed insights for active members.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of available classes for memberships.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all available classes associated with memberships. It returns detailed information about each class, including schedules, instructors, and more. Ideal for users looking to explore their options.
